app_identity.name: TrendSell — Product & Sales Intelligence Dashboard
app_identity.theme_strategy: Dark mode default (#0B0F17 base) with seamless light mode toggle option (#F8FAFC base). Monochromatic surface elevation with vibrant signal accents (Emerald #10B981 for demand, Indigo #6366F1 for tech, Violet #8B5CF6 for TikTok trends, Amber #F59E0B for warnings).
app_identity.mood: Precision command center, tactile analytics, high-speed data flow, clear opportunity scoring

sidebar.type: Fixed collapsible desktop sidebar, slide-over mobile menu

elements: Brand logo 'TrendSell' with live pulse status indicator
Global Search Input with shortcut hint (Ctrl+K / Cmd+K)
Refresh Data trigger button with AI spin loader animation
Dark / Light theme switch toggle button
Notification bell with recent opportunity alerts count badge

grid_modes.kpi_bar: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 mb-6
grid_modes.product_cards: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-6

home_dashboard.search_and_filter: Category pills (All, Electronics, Beauty, Home & Living, Fitness, Fashion, Gadgets) + live keyword search + demand filter slider

features: High quality product image from curated Unsplash library
Demand trend score ring or horizontal bar gauge
Category tag with custom badge styling
Key driver platform badges (TikTok, Meta, Amazon, Shopify)
Quick Deep Dive button (triggers detail modal or page)

product_deep_dive.overview: Product banner, detailed overview, current monthly sales estimation, why it is trending breakdown
product_deep_dive.market_opportunity_gauge: Visual semi-circle radial gauge or progress bar with score (0-100), risk index, and growth potential label
product_deep_dive.sales_drivers: Structured list of ecosystem apps/tools driving sales (e.g. Kalodata, Motion Ads, Loox Reviews, Triple Whale, Helium10) with contribution breakdown % and strategy explanation
product_deep_dive.recharts_analytics: Area / Line chart showing 6-month demand trajectory vs search volume index across platforms

research_engine.refresh_button: Triggers backend AI research request with real-time progress modal/toast step indicators ('Scanning TikTok Shop API...', 'Analyzing Meta Ad Library...', 'Scraping Amazon Best Sellers...')

motion_and_interactions.hover_effects: Slight upward translation (-translate-y-1), border color shift to accent ring, smooth shadow projection
motion_and_interactions.framer_motion: Page container entrance fade-in, staggered list items for product grid, dialog drawer slide-in for product deep dive modal

testing_and_accessibility.contrast_rule: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 text contrast. Never rely on transparent backgrounds for header or popups.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the dashboard using React + Tailwind with Lucide React icons and Recharts.
Ensure dark mode is enabled by default with dark root styling (dark class on html/wrapper), and support toggle to light mode using local state / next-themes pattern.
Incorporate all testids listed in testing_and_accessibility.
Populate initial state with rich realistic e-commerce trending product data across multiple categories (Electronics, Beauty, Fitness, Home, Fashion).
Implement the simulated or FastAPI backend trigger for 'Refresh Data' with simulated AI scan stages and Sonner toast notifications.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for overlays, modals, or dropdown menus.
